Inspect a pyramid file

Source: R/read.R
a5_pyramid_info.Rd

Reads the footer of a file written by a5_write_pyramid(), its index and Parquet layout, without reading any rows. This is what a browser fetches first, so footer_bytes is the cost of opening the file there.

Usage

a5_pyramid_info(src)

Arguments

src

Path of a pyramid Parquet file.

Value

A list of class a5pyramid_info:

  • path, bytes (file size), footer_bytes (Parquet footer, index included).

  • format_version, generator, a5_crate (the a5 crate that built the file) and a5_index (the A5 index version of its ids).

  • data_resolution: the leaves' resolution. lods: every level's LOD, ascending, the leaves last.

  • tile_size: the most rows in a tile.

  • bbox: c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) of the leaves.

  • columns: a tibble of the value columns' name, type, reducer and sd, the standard deviation that scaled a "rep_child" column (1 where the leaves' standard deviation is 0 or undefined; NA for other reducers and older files).

  • levels: a tibble of each level's lod, rows and number of tiles.

  • tiles: a tibble with one row per tile, which is one row group of the file: tile (its 0-based index, the row group's index as Parquet readers count), lod, rows, bytes (compressed size, what a reader fetches) and xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax.

  • metadata: the file's other key-value metadata, a named character vector.

  • shard: for a shard of a pyramid set (format version 2, written by a5_write_pyramid_set()), a list of its tier, shard cell (hex) and its shard resolution; NULL for a single file.

Details

Longitudes follow the a5R stack's convention: a box across the antimeridian has xmax above 180, as a5R::a5_bbox() reports. The file itself stores such a box with west > east, as GeoJSON does.

See also

a5_read_pyramid() to read rows.

Examples

library(a5R)
centre <- a5_lonlat_to_cell(-3.19, 55.95, resolution = 10)
cells <- a5_uncompact(a5_spherical_cap(centre, 3000), resolution = 15)
path <- tempfile(fileext = ".parquet")
a5_write_pyramid(data.frame(cell = cells, value = runif(length(cells))), path)

info <- a5_pyramid_info(path)
info
#> ── a5pyramid file file29e139449845.parquet ─────────────────────────────────────
#> Size: 17.1 KB (footer 4.6 KB)
#> A5 index: 1.0
#> Leaves: resolution 15, 1,024 cells
#> LODs: 2-15 (14 levels)
#> Rows: 1,426
#> Tiles: 14 row groups (tile size 4096)

#> Bbox: -3.2194, 55.9355, -3.127, 56.0338
#> Written by: a5pyramid 0.0.0.9000, a5 crate 1.0.0
